summary: Russian forces launched ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv and Kharkiv, causing casualties and infrastructure damage. Ukraine received $3.35 billion in World Bank funding for macro-financial stability. Russia temporarily suspended navigation through the Donetsk-Azov canal and Kerch Strait, disrupting grain exports.
key_points: Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv overnight, killing 10 people including a child and causing fires in office buildings and a railway locomotive. (Source: @UkraineNow/82561)
Ukraine received $3.35 billion from the World Bank for macro-financial stability and priority budget expenditures. (Source: @UkraineNow/82565)
Russia temporarily suspended navigation through the Donetsk-Azov canal and Kerch Strait, halting grain exports. (Source: @UkraineNow/82566)
Ukrainian air defense systems lack capability to intercept Russian ballistic missiles, Zelensky stated. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31549)
Russian attacks damaged fuel infrastructure, prompting plans for temporary fuel dispensers at gas stations. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31552)
Ukrainian forces destroyed 21 tankers, 4 tugboats, 2 bulk carriers, and a special vessel in the Sea of Azov. (Source: @eRadarrua/100603)
Russian Su-34 and Su-57 aircraft operate in the Black Sea, threatening Odesa region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68837)
Ukrainian President Zelensky called for banning the OU-N-UPA flag in Poland over historical disputes. (Source: @UkraineNow/82582)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces intensified attacks on Kyiv and Kharkiv with ballistic missiles, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Ukraine secured $3.35 billion in World Bank funding to support macro-financial stability. Russia disrupted grain exports by suspending navigation through the Donetsk-Azov canal and Kerch Strait.

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure and civilian areas, with ballistic missiles targeting Kyiv and Kharkiv. Ukraine's inability to intercept these missiles poses a critical vulnerability. Russia's disruption of grain exports through the Donetsk-Azov canal threatens global food security. NATO support delays may weaken Ukraine's defensive capabilities. Russian naval operations in the Black Sea threaten Odesa's economic lifelines.
sections.regional_response: Polish President Duda called for banning the OU-N-UPA flag in Poland over historical disputes with Ukrainian nationalists. EU temporary protection status for Ukrainian refugees increased in Italy and Germany but decreased in Poland and Bulgaria. NATO continues discussions on missile defense support for Ukraine. International grain markets react to Russian canal closures affecting Black Sea exports.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian missile launchers in Bryansk region enable three-minute flight time to Kyiv, explaining delayed air raid alerts. Ukrainian fuel infrastructure vulnerability may require temporary dispensers at gas stations. DeepState map shows Russian advances near Atishky village in Kharkiv region. TASS reports Russian strikes on Ukrainian port infrastructure including Izmail. SkyFall drone production facilities visited by US Senator Grem indicate ongoing Western military support.
